entries.note: The order is entered in Délivro's system, before a driver collects the parcel.
The French wording of the same checkpoint, which the tracker gives when asked in French.
A driver collects the parcel at the pickup stop.
The tracker flags it as an interruption and asks the reader to call Délivro to resolve it; in the sample, for missing information. Its status code stays the order's, picked up.
The hold is lifted and the parcel moves on.

An order status, the order's and its checkpoints', not a scan. The tracking page's script names it Received, the first step of its rail. The adapter reads it for the order only when no checkpoint has a stage.
An order status: a driver is assigned to collect the parcel, which Délivro does not hold yet. The rail's second step.
An order status: the rail's third step.
An order status the script names EnRoute. The rail counts it past the pickup and before the delivery without a step of its own, and nothing ties it to the delivery round.
An order status: the rail's last step.
An order status the script names Cancelled; the rail shows no step for it.
